## 🏛️ Ecosystem Overview

TidyFactor develops production-grade, deterministic AI Coding Agent Skills engineered for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

### Core Ecosystem Tracks:
1. **Governance & Architecture**: Master engineering frameworks, skill governance, and quality bars.
2. **Platform & Microservices**: Multi-tenant SaaS, modular PHP kernels, and hypermedia architectures.
3. **Developer Experience & Tooling**: Documentation generators, repository operations, and styling engines.
